title: FlexMoE: Learning One-for-All Multi-Budget Expert Pruning for Flexible MoE Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2606.27866v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing and serving all experts. Moreover, deployment budgets can vary substantially across devices, users, and workloads. Existing MoE compression methods typically optimize a separate compressed model for each target budget. We introduce FlexMoE, a post-training one-for-all framework that converts a large pretrained MoE model into a multi-budget family of smaller deployable subnetworks. FlexMoE first ranks expert FFN channels by importance to construct a sliceable weight space shared across budgets, and then learns expert-wise discrete retention actions under gradually increasing cost pressure, allowing a single action-training run to produce reliable pruning masks across budgets. translated_title: FlexMoE：学习面向灵活MoE部署的一体化多预算专家剪枝
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型通过稀疏的专家激活来扩展模型容量，但在部署时仍需存储和服务所有专家。此外，部署预算在不同设备、用户和工作负载之间可能存在显著差异。现有的MoE压缩方法通常需要为每个目标预算单独优化一个压缩模型。我们提出了FlexMoE，这是一个训练后的“一体化”框架，能够将大型预训练MoE模型转换为一系列多预算的、更小的可部署子网络。FlexMoE首先按重要性对专家FFN通道进行排序，构建一个跨预算共享的可切片权重空间，然后在逐渐增加的成本压力下学习专家级的离散保留动作，使得单次动作训练即可产生跨预算的可靠剪枝掩码。此外，仅需一次中等预算的微调即可进一步恢复性能下降，并产出一个共享的恢复模型……（原文截断）
tldr: FlexMoE提出了一种训练后的一体化多预算专家剪枝框架，通过构建跨预算共享的可切片权重空间和学习专家级保留动作，将大型预训练MoE模型转换为可灵活部署的多预算子网络家族。
en_tdlr: FlexMoE is a post-training one-for-all framework that converts a large pretrained MoE model into a multi-budget family of deployable subnetworks by ranking expert FFN channels to build a sliceable shared weight space and learning expert-wise discrete retention actions across budgets.
